title: Transpose a matrix
prompt:
Write transpose(matrix) that takes a list of equal-length rows and returns the matrix with rows and columns swapped.
Example: [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]] -> [[1, 4], [2, 5], [3, 6]]. An empty matrix gives [].
hints: Draw the matrix as a grid. The first row of the answer is the first column of the original: which items form it?
The answer has as many rows as the original has columns. For each column number, collect that position from every original row.
Plan: return [] for an empty matrix; for each column index c from 0 to (number of columns - 1) build a new row from row[c] for every row; collect those rows in a list.

edge_hints.empty: An empty matrix has no first row to measure the columns from. Handle it first.
